3.2.6.name: scripts.pullbase.load_pull_entries

3.2.7.name: scripts.pullbase.load_runtime_config

3.2.8.name: scripts.pullbase.parse_args

3.2.10.name: scripts.pullbase.resolve_template_path

3.2.11.name: scripts.pullbase.sync_manifests

3.2.12.name: scripts.pullbase.load_once_entries

6.name: utils
6.description: Reusable runtime, conversion, loading, and testing utilities.

6.1.name: utils.baseutils
6.1.description: Core runtime utility module that provides configuration composition, HTML rendering, logging, output persistence, and the Main lifecycle.

6.1.1.name: utils.baseutils.trackit
6.1.1.description: Track function execution and return result with extensible metrics.

6.1.2.name: utils.baseutils.dict_merge
6.1.2.description: Recursively merge override dict into base dict and return the merged result.

6.1.3.name: utils.baseutils.Params
6.1.3.description: Simple container that exposes dictionary values as attributes and supports deep merge, evaluation, and placeholder population.

6.1.3.1.name: utils.baseutils.Params.set
6.1.3.1.description: Deep-merge keyword parameters into the container and expose them as attributes.

6.1.3.2.name: utils.baseutils.Params.get
6.1.3.2.description: Get a value (or chain of values) by attribute key.

6.1.3.3.name: utils.baseutils.Params.get_dict
6.1.3.3.description: Return the container contents as a plain dict.

6.1.3.4.name: utils.baseutils.Params.evaluate
6.1.3.4.description: Resolve placeholder references inside COMMON (or other named) nodes.

6.1.3.5.name: utils.baseutils.Params.populate
6.1.3.5.description: Substitute placeholder wrappers across the container using COMMON values.

6.1.4.name: utils.baseutils.Config
6.1.4.description: Load, merge, evaluate, and populate runtime configuration.

6.1.5.name: utils.baseutils.resolve_dotted
6.1.5.description: Resolve object, Params, and dict values by dotted path syntax.

6.1.6.name: utils.baseutils.HtmlDoc
6.1.6.description: Render DataFrame, dict, and list datasets into HTML documents via template files.

6.1.6.1.name: utils.baseutils.HtmlDoc.load_template
6.1.6.1.description: Load the configured HTML template from disk.

6.1.6.2.name: utils.baseutils.HtmlDoc.to_html
6.1.6.2.description: Render the current dataset into an HTML string using the loaded template.

6.1.6.3.name: utils.baseutils.HtmlDoc.save
6.1.6.3.description: Save the rendered HTML document to the given output path.

6.1.7.name: utils.baseutils.load_message_lookup
6.1.7.description: Load and concatenate message dictionary CSV files, deduplicating by code.

6.1.8.name: utils.baseutils.create_logger
6.1.8.description: Create a logger instance using configured paths, verbosity, and message dictionaries.

6.1.9.name: utils.baseutils.Logger
6.1.9.description: Simple logger that stores messages, emits console output, persists append-only CSV logs, renders HTML logs, and publishes a runtime data map.

6.1.9.18.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log
6.1.9.18.description: Store a message or data payload with the current timestamp.

6.1.9.19.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.update_data_map
6.1.9.19.description: Merge a normalized data payload into the logger's runtime data map.

6.1.9.20.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.get_data_map_snapshot
6.1.9.20.description: Return a shallow snapshot of the current data map.

6.1.9.21.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.resolve_data
6.1.9.21.description: Resolve a dotted path against the data map, returning a default when missing.

6.1.9.22.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.save_html
6.1.9.22.description: Render and persist the collected log events as an HTML document.

6.1.10.name: utils.baseutils.save
6.1.10.description: Save data to JSON, CSV, or HTML outputs using runtime-aware serialization rules.

6.1.12.name: utils.baseutils.get_config
6.1.12.description: Convenience loader that returns an evaluated Params object for the given config path.

6.1.13.name: utils.baseutils.tryeval
6.1.13.description: Best-effort literal-evaluate a value, returning the original on failure.

6.1.14.name: utils.baseutils.try_except
6.1.14.description: Run a callable and return a default value (logging optionally) when it raises.

6.1.15.name: utils.baseutils.add_to_dict
6.1.15.description: Add keyword parameters into a dict in place and return the updated dict.

6.1.16.name: utils.baseutils.as_list
6.1.16.description: Coerce a scalar or iterable value into a list.

6.1.11.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager
6.1.11.description: Main runtime lifecycle class that loads inputs, processes data, stores outputs, and finalizes run state.

6.1.11.1.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.load_data
6.1.11.1.description: Load all enabled config.input entries into results targets; persists per-input last_modified maps in self.input_meta to support DataLoader delta mode across cycles.

6.1.11.2.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.process_data
6.1.11.2.description: Run configured processing steps against loaded results data.

6.1.11.3.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.store_outputs
6.1.11.3.description: Persist configured outputs sequentially or concurrently via ThreadPoolExecutor based on CONFIG.COMMON.OUTPUT_WORKERS. Supports split artifacts and output-level delta flag backed by a sha256 checksum manifest. Per-worker exceptions are caught and logged as BASEW06 without aborting remaining writes.

6.1.11.4.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.close
6.1.11.4.description: Finalize the run state and prepare runtime artifacts for saving.

6.1.11.5.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.run
6.1.11.5.description: Run the full data loading and processing pipeline, then store outputs.

6.1.11.6.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.create_results
6.1.11.6.description: Initialize the in-memory results container that holds per-target loaded and processed data.

6.1.11.7.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.touch_result
6.1.11.7.description: Update a result target's last-modified timestamp from a source descriptor.

6.1.11.8.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.open_output
6.1.11.8.description: Open a previously saved output artifact for a given output key.

6.1.11.9.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager._store_one_output
6.1.11.9.description: Resolve, convert, and persist a single configured output artifact; callable from both sequential loop and ThreadPoolExecutor worker threads in store_outputs.

6.2.name: utils.datautils
6.2.description: Data conversion and file loading utilities used by the runtime pipeline.

6.2.1.name: utils.datautils.DataFrameConverter
6.2.1.description: Securely applies transformation rules to a pandas DataFrame.

6.2.1.1.name: utils.datautils.DataFrameConverter.apply
6.2.1.1.description: Apply the configured transformation rules to a pandas DataFrame and return the result. Supports a 'custom' scope that evaluates the op expression against the converter's context dict and returns the raw result directly, bypassing the DataFrame column-assignment path.

6.2.2.name: utils.datautils.DataLoader
6.2.2.description: Load files from a source file or folder using configurable format and optional logging. Supports an input-level `delta` flag: in delta mode the loader rescans the source on every call and only loads files that are new or whose on-disk mtime changed since the previous load, tracking per-file mtimes in last_modified.

6.2.2.1.name: utils.datautils.DataLoader.load
6.2.2.1.description: Load files from the configured source (file or folder), honoring delta mode and updating last_modified.

6.3.1.3.name: utils.testutils.TestManager.run_phase

6.3.1.4.name: utils.testutils.TestManager.start_live

6.3.1.5.name: utils.testutils.TestManager.stop_live

6.3.1.6.name: utils.testutils.TestManager.finalize

6.3.1.7.name: utils.testutils.TestManager.run_a_test

6.3.2.name: utils.testutils.build_test_config

6.3.3.name: utils.testutils.evaluate_checks

6.3.4.name: utils.testutils.monitor_activity
